cards.description: Define Aurora (Agent-Unified Representation of Requirements and Architecture) using Aurora itself: a deterministic, machine-consumable architecture model rooted at a single Mission card, backed by schemas and canonical registries, and usable by tools and agents.
cards.name: Model Aurora With Aurora

cards.description: Validate a model home by loading cards, applying schema checks, validating canonical relationship constraints, and enforcing reachability and root-direction invariants.
cards.name: Validate Model

cards.description: Maintain the canonical registries and schemas that define the Aurora vocabulary and view semantics.
cards.name: Maintain Canonical Registries

cards.description: Render view artifacts by selecting roots, traversing reachable subgraphs, and generating diagrams and related assets from the model.
cards.name: Render Views

cards.description: Export a compact representation of the model cards and links into a single JSON file.
cards.name: Export Compact Model

cards.description: Record create/change/delete events for mission cards into the mission audit log.
cards.name: Record Audit Log Entries

cards.description: The Mission card serves as the root of the model graph and must only have outgoing links.
cards.name: Mission Has Outgoing Links Only

cards.description: Every non-Mission card must have one or more incoming links and be reachable from the Mission card.
cards.name: No Orphan Cards

cards.description: Models must use the standard Aurora folder layout: Mission card at model home, mission-scoped cards under `<MISSION_ID>/<Card Type>/`, and an audit log at `<MISSION_ID>/AuditLog.json`.
cards.name: Standard Model File Layout

cards.description: As an architect, I want to express architecture and requirements as a validated, deterministic model so that tools and agents can reason about it, generate consistent views, and avoid ambiguity.
cards.name: Deterministic Modeling Experience

cards.description: Command-line tooling for validating Aurora models, generating views, and exporting compact representations.
cards.name: Aurora CLI

cards.description: Interactive editor application for browsing, validating, rendering, and editing Aurora models with trust gating.
cards.name: Aurora Editor

cards.description: Generate view diagrams and related artifacts from an Aurora model based on the view definitions registry.
cards.name: Render Views

cards.description: Browse and edit Aurora cards interactively while preserving schema validity and model invariants.
cards.name: Interactive Model Editing

cards.description: Validate an Aurora model against schemas, registries, and graph invariants, producing actionable diagnostics.
cards.name: Validate Model

cards.description: Provide model operations (discover/load/validate/render/export and CRUD) to the editor UI with trust gating.
cards.name: Editor Model Operations

cards.description: Export an Aurora compact model representation suitable for agent consumption and transport.
cards.name: Export Compact Model

cards.description: Rendered view artifacts (for example SVG diagrams and DOT sources) generated from a model and view definitions.
cards.name: View Diagram Artifacts

cards.description: The compact JSON export of the model cards and links for transport and agent consumption.
cards.name: Compact Export

cards.description: The per-mission audit log JSON file that records create/change/delete events over time.
cards.name: Mission Audit Log

cards.description: The Aurora JSON schemas used to validate cards, audit logs, and compact exports.
cards.name: Aurora Schemas

cards.description: The canonical registry JSON that defines card types, acronyms, and allowed outgoing relationships.
cards.name: Canonical Definitions Registry

cards.description: The canonical registry JSON that defines views (roots, included card types, and view descriptions).
cards.name: View Definitions Registry

cards.description: Diagnostics output describing schema, registry, and invariant validation results for a model home.
cards.name: Validation Report

cards.description: Model homes MUST contain the shared Aurora schemas, and missions MUST follow the standard folder layout for cards and audit logs.
cards.name: Standard Model Home Layout

cards.description: Each mission MUST have an audit log recording create/change/delete events with timestamp, editor, target id, and change type.
cards.name: Audit Log Semantics

cards.description: Rendering MUST treat canonical registry style fields (shape/icon/fill/color) as non-normative hints; model validity MUST depend on normative fields (types, ids, relationships), not styling.
cards.name: Rendering Semantics

cards.description: Starting from the Mission, all links MUST traverse away from the Mission; every card must be reachable; and traversal must terminate in a leaf or a previously seen card (local loop).
cards.name: Directed Graph Invariants

cards.description: A canonical registry MUST define the available card types, their id acronyms, and the allowed outgoing relationship targets and verbs for each card type.
cards.name: Canonical Definitions Registry

cards.description: A model MUST include exactly one Mission card as the root intent, with only outgoing links, summarizing the high-level why of the model.
cards.name: Single Mission Root

cards.description: A compact, single-file representation MUST be supported for transport and agent consumption, using the compact schema and retaining card ids, types, fields, and links.
cards.name: Compact Model Format

cards.description: View definitions MUST specify root card types and included card types; view roots MUST exclude cards participating in cycles (root safety rule).
cards.name: View Definitions And Root Safety

cards.description: Cards MUST conform to the Aurora card schema (required fields, identifier format, and link structure) and be stored as pretty-printed JSON.
cards.name: Schema-Backed Card Format

cards.description: Default tooling SHOULD validate models, generate human-readable outputs, generate views, and export compact models from the source cards.
cards.name: Default Tooling Support

cards.description: The overall Aurora system: schemas + canonical registries + model cards, supported by tools (CLI/editor/shared library) that validate models and generate views and exports.
cards.name: Aurora Tooling Ecosystem

cards.description: The editor’s frontend UI that calls the backend API, displays validation diagnostics, and provides interactive navigation and editing experiences.
cards.name: Editor Frontend UI

cards.description: Shared Rust library providing registry-aware parsing, validation helpers, and rendering primitives used by Aurora tools.
cards.name: Aurora Shared Library

cards.description: A trust-gated Rust backend exposing model discovery, snapshot loading, validation, rendering, exports, and card CRUD operations to the editor UI.
cards.name: Tauri Rust Backend

cards.description: The aurora_cli executable that exposes validate/render/compact commands to users and pipelines.
cards.name: Aurora CLI Binary

cards.description: Generate view artifacts from the model by selecting roots and included card types, traversing reachable subgraphs, and rendering diagrams without changing the underlying model.
cards.name: Generate Views

cards.description: Validate that an Aurora model conforms to schemas, canonical registries, and graph invariants (reachability, root direction, and no-orphan rules).
cards.name: Validate Aurora Models

cards.description: Maintain the canonical registries (card definitions and view definitions) that govern model validation and view generation.
cards.name: Maintain Canonical Registries

cards.description: Maintain an audit log per mission that records deterministic create/change/delete events for cards.
cards.name: Maintain Audit Trail

cards.description: Export an agent-friendly compact model representation containing the cards and their directed links in a single JSON document.
cards.name: Export Compact Model

cards.description: Maintain the canonical registry of card types and allowed outgoing relationships.
cards.name: Edit Canonical Definitions Registry

cards.description: Load cards from the model home and validate them against schemas, canonical registries, and graph invariants.
cards.name: Validate Model Home

cards.description: Maintain the canonical registry of view definitions (roots, included types, and view intent).
cards.name: Edit View Definitions Registry

cards.description: Append a create/change/delete entry to the mission audit log.
cards.name: Append Audit Log Entry

cards.description: Select roots/included card types per view definitions, traverse the subgraph, and render the view into diagram artifacts.
cards.name: Render View Artifacts

cards.description: Write the compact export JSON document for transport and agent consumption.
cards.name: Write Compact Export

cards.description: Maintain the Aurora JSON schemas used for cards, audit logs, and compact export.
cards.name: Maintain Aurora Schemas

cards.description: Provide a single, normative registry for card types and allowed relationship targets/verbs so models can be validated and interpreted consistently across tools.
cards.name: Canonical Vocabulary

cards.description: Eliminate ambiguous architectural meaning by enforcing invariant rules and schema-backed cards so that any interpretation (views, traceability, impact analysis) is reproducible.
cards.name: Deterministic Interpretation

cards.description: Enable tools to generate consistent diagrams and documentation from the model without manually drawing or maintaining multiple sources of truth.
cards.name: Automated View Generation

cards.description: Humans and automation (LLMs, agents, validation/render tooling) that need a shared, unambiguous representation of architecture and requirements.
cards.name: Architects And Agents

cards.description: The interface contract between the editor UI and the Tauri backend for model operations (discover/load/validate/render/export and card CRUD).
cards.name: Editor Backend API
